h1: Custom Gray Fleece for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom gray fleece jackets in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate gifts.
introHtml: Gray fleece offers a neutral, professional look that works for any industry, from construction sites to corporate offices. The Boundary Fleece Jacket, for example, provides warmth and durability with a subtle color that hides dirt well. Customize with your logo using embroidery or screen printing for a cohesive team uniform or promotional giveaway.
heroAltText: Custom gray fleece jacket with embroidered logo on front, perfect for corporate branding
